tension: coderepair-01 refuted the domain-general claim, but its failure profile named a specific cause: models missed guards rather than slipping on arithmetic, and stating the defect first did not make them notice the requirement. Two readings remain live. Either the mechanism does not generalise and step-calc was the wrong intermediate step for writing code, or step-calc's value depends on matching the task's structure. Testing the same policy again cannot separate them; only changing the policy can. Answering it decides whether the paper contributes a bounded mechanism with a stated boundary or a domain-general protocol effect, and it is the only remaining lever on the two dimensions the venue reviewer scores lowest.
